response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, (i.product_cost - i.total_cost) / NULLIF(i.total_cost, 0) AS relative_gap, i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
